title: August 2017 / Spectrum Retail Mall Guide
slide_intent: Identify the guide’s setting and edition so a reader knows which instructions apply.
strategic_value: A restrained blue cover can establish continuity before the reader reaches retail applications.
demonstration: White type identifies the date and guide at upper left and repeats Retail Mall at a much larger scale along the bottom of a deep blue field.
practical_value: Distinguish this historical retail guide from later Spectrum identity systems.

content_islands.name: Edition block
content_islands.spec: Set the month, year, Spectrum name and guide title as three short lines at upper left.

content_islands.name: Retail Mall title
content_islands.spec: Anchor the large title to the lower-left edge of the deep blue field.
